tasks.title: Grantable builtin facade tools on setup cards (Part A, both lanes)
tasks.objective: In autonomousGrantRecovery (shared/tool-execution-policy-service.ts): keep the existing projected browser.use branch first, then before the exact-tool-grants fallback canonicalize via publicGantryToolNameForSdkTool and, if isGantryFacadeExactToolRule matches, emit request_access kind:tool with the canonical name so facade tools (WebSearch/WebRead/FileRead/Browser/FileWrite/FileEdit) become one-tap grantable on setup cards. Both lanes. No durable-access-policy change; no new decision.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled denial of a canonical facade tool is grantable (request_access kind:tool) and produces a working one-tap grant that persists the canonical selection + appends the canonical job requirement; projected browser.use branch preserved; third-party MCP + locked stay non-grantable.
verify_commands: npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/shared apps/core/test/unit/application

required_tests.id: autonomousGrantRecovery > canonical facade tool WebSearch is grantable via request_access kind:tool
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Neutral (both lanes); button works on tap (durable acceptance already exists); browser branch + non-grantable classes intact.

tasks.title: Single-event async actionable card at job creation (Part B)
tasks.objective: Add a single-event application-owned notification port on the job-management deps that, on a creation readiness blocker, dispatches ONE actionable setup-pause card and publishes exactly one JOB_SETUP_REQUIRED event (do NOT also call the runtime notifier from the application layer). Wire it in runtime composition for BOTH the Control route and jobs/ipc-scheduler-create-handlers.ts. Dispatch async (not awaited) so creation stays fast; rely on notified_fingerprint dedup vs the later run pause.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a job blocked on a missing declared tool fires exactly one actionable setup card and one JOB_SETUP_REQUIRED event; wired for both Control and IPC creation paths; async (creation not slowed); a later runtime pause for the same blocker produces no second card; no architecture-layer violation.
verify_commands: npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application apps/core/test/unit/jobs && npm run check:architecture

required_tests.id: job creation > blocked job fires exactly one actionable setup card and one event
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: single event (no double-publish); application-owned port (no runtime import); both creation paths wired; async; fingerprint dedup.
